facts.fact: The Treasury's addendum says the Konza National Data Centre uses 2N utility power with dual independent feeds from Kenya Power plus 2N+1 backup generators and a 2N UPS; no date is given for the feeds, so the document's date of 2026-04-13 is used.
The Treasury's addendum says the Konza National Data Centre operates at a PUE of approximately 1.45; the document's date of 2026-04-13 is used.
